entries.title: Job vehicles keep their tuning, mark the garage a vehicle is parked in

changes.text: Job and gang vehicles keep their tuning: the look set in the job vehicle list (engine, paint, livery, extras) is applied only until the vehicle is stored for the first time, later upgrades are no longer reset on every take-out
Garage menu: when transfers are off, a vehicle parked in another garage shows a "Mark garage" button that sets a GPS waypoint to that garage
Vehicle list editor: "Take from my vehicle" now picks up the turbo

entries.title: Send player vehicles to impound from the panel, searchable lists for big servers

changes.text: Admin panel > Player vehicles: send a player's vehicle to any impound lot (opens a case without a fine, the owner is notified)
Players who quit inside an interior garage are put back at the entrance again on servers with a character menu or spawn selector
Every long dropdown (garage pickers with hundreds of garages) has a search field
Garage list: one "Show" dropdown with counts (Public, Job, Gang, Private / property, Impound, Disabled, Needs setup) and groups that fold with a click
Player vehicles: change the fine, extend the hold or release an impounded vehicle for free
Player vehicles: mark a vehicle that is out in the world on the map or teleport next to it
Player vehicles: "All vehicles of the owner" lists every vehicle of that player
Garages that use a job vehicle list or an interior open on click; "+N" shows the rest
Player vehicles show the vehicle's name and make instead of the model hash
The garage list search also finds garages by job or gang name, and group headers show the job's label
The "move to" list shows garages and impound lots under separate headers, each row tagged Garage or Impound
Saving or discarding on the Impound lots tab no longer saves or throws away unsaved changes from Global rules

entries.title: Vehicle types checked everywhere, job vehicles from moved databases

changes.text: Air and sea garages and impound lots no longer list or hand out cars (and car garages no longer list helicopters) when the server did not know a vehicle's type yet, e.g. after a restart or with vehicles from an older garage script
Taking out, moving between garages, recovering lost vehicles, interior garages and impound release now check the vehicle type on the server too
An impounded vehicle is released at a lot of its own type, also when an older import put it on a lot of another type
Job vehicles of a vehicle table that never went through the import (database moved from a test server) are tagged from the old job column once on start, so job garages take them again
A garage's key can no longer be changed while vehicles or open impound cases use it
The start-up import check reads the vehicle table once instead of once per old garage script

entries.title: Admin control over key re-sharing, shared vehicle exports and lower client usage

changes.text: Admin setting "Key holders can share with others" (General rules > Key sharing), off by default: players who received a key can no longer pass it on unless an admin turns it on
Server exports IsVehicleShared(plate, identifier?) and GetVehicleShares(plate), so other scripts (tax, insurance) can check whether a vehicle's key is shared
Much lower client usage away from garages: prompts, markers and parking bays only run when a garage is actually in reach, no longer whenever any garage is within 150 m
Lower client usage while driving: only the garages around your vehicle are checked for parking bays, not every garage on the map
Real parking uses less client time near parking lots: prompts only look at the slots next to you and parked copies are checked less often
Prompt, drawing and key loops wake up less often while nothing is shown
With debug on, restarting another resource no longer prints the chosen notify / fuel / keys scripts again
Keys shared earlier with the "share with others" permission lose that permission while the new setting is off
Classic and real parking garages in one script, mode chosen per garage; car, air and sea garages with public, job, gang, private and property access
Impound with a police form, preset and custom fines, hold times, release fees, disputes, auto-tow and abandoned vehicle cleanup
In-game admin panel for garages, interiors, impound lots, vehicle lists and player vehicles, with freecam placement and JSON export / import
Vehicle photo studio: /garagephotos takes transparent vehicle pictures in game, and garage cards show each car in its owner's paint colour
Garage menu with search, sort, filters, favourites, nicknames and GPS; bring vehicles from other garages and return lost ones for a fee
Fuel, engine, body, props and damage (doors, windows, tyres, deformation) are saved and restored
Real parking: vehicles stay in their slots near the player, optional tarps, drive straight out of the slot
Job and gang vehicles with minimum grade, purchase lists paid by the player or the group account, livery and extras on take out
Transfer between garages, give to a nearby player, key sharing with permissions and duration, sell to the dealer or a player
Private garages for sale or rent, and interior garages with cinematic entry, slots and multiple exits
Trailers are stored and restored with their vehicle; optional insurance with offices and durations
/garageimport takes over garages from jg-advancedgarages, tgiann-realparking, qb-garages / qbx_garages and esx garages, with a preview
Works as a drop-in for scripts that call qb-garages, jg-advancedgarages or tgiann-realparking
Auto detected fuel, keys, notify, banking, housing, phone, target, text UI and radial scripts
Discord webhooks for every action, English and Turkish languages
